# OpenProgram 0.9.0 Release Notes

OpenProgram 0.9.0 adds self-update and restart recovery, so supported conversations and functions can continue from saved progress after the framework restarts.

## ✨ New features

- **Resume after an update or restart.** Interrupted work can recover automatically within a two-hour window. A conversation that updates the framework can resume and continue checking the result.
- **Choose which code continues.** Keep the original function code with `keep_original` (the default), or select `use_latest` to reuse completed steps and run the remaining compatible steps with updated code. The Continue control can override the configured policy.
- **Recover function progress.** Supported functions retain completed steps, nested workflow progress, and named parallel results. Functions invoked from chat or directly return their results to the original caller.

Recovery respects explicit pause and cancellation. Functions must opt in and define durable steps; arbitrary running Python functions cannot resume at an arbitrary instruction. Incompatible code changes pause for attention, and external operations with an unknown outcome require reconciliation before continuing. See the [function recovery guide](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/blob/v0.9.0/docs/reference/api/agentic-function.md) for supported code and limitations.

### CLI / Server

Install this release on macOS or Linux; the installer selects the architecture and verifies the runtime:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | OPENPROGRAM_VERSION=0.9.0 sh
```

## 🔄 Upgrade guide

- **Desktop:** download the matching DMG above and replace the existing application in `/Applications`.
- **CLI / Server:** run `openprogram upgrade`, or repeat the versioned installation command above.
- **Your data:** configuration, conversations, Programs, and saved progress under `~/.openprogram` are preserved.
- **After upgrading:** check `openprogram --version` and review any interrupted work. The recovery window defaults to two hours; explicit pauses, cancellations, and incompatible code changes are not silently overridden.

See the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/blob/v0.9.0/docs/install/upgrade.md) for details.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Preserve cancellation, approval, permissions, and execution ownership during recovery.
- Fix a shutdown race that could interrupt resource-budget checks.
- Preserve file identity during recoverable file operations, including case-only directory renames.
- Fix Windows snapshot metadata checks and flushing of migrated session files.

## 🚀 Improvements

- Verify complete runtimes, desktop packages, and CLI installations before publishing.
- Provide checksums and a machine-readable manifest for release downloads.
